newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 2.38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 2.38 pct.

text.p: Pakistan polyester-maker Dewan Salman Fibre Ltd 10-rupee stock rose one rupee, or 2.38 percent, to 43.00 on fresh buying after it cut the rate of polyester staple fibre by 0.75 rupee per kg and fixed the price at 69 rupees per kg.
About one million shares were traded in the morning at the Karachi Stock Exchange, one dealer said.
The dealer said the firm's profitability was likely to rise after the cut, which would boost sales, as locally-produced polyester staple fibre would be cheaper than imported one.
